title: BoardGameGeek Hotness
content:
1. **Cola Wars**
*2026*
It's 1985.  You're in charge of marketing for a radical cola brand.  Enjoy, or else.
![Cola Wars](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_1435cbf3.jpg)

2. **Lionwake**
*2027*
Lions leap to the sound of your drum to repel the Nian beasts.
![Lionwake](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_84f9c2e8.jpg)

3. **Timespan**
*2026*
Lead your civilization from the stone age to the space age in 90 minutes.
![Timespan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_bed60362.jpg)

4. **Hellas**
*2016*
Expand your cities, glorifying them with magnificent structures to vie for victory!
![Hellas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_17718611.jpg)

5. **ASHES: Blackout Protocol**
*2026*
From the ashes, the Phoenix will rise again.
![ASHES: Blackout Protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_b6b8ae0b.png)

6. **Dino Battle!**
*2027*
Ride. Roar. Conquer. A dinosaur riding dice-chucking miniatures game for 2-4 players.
![Dino Battle!](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_a0c42039.png)

7. **Deckers**
*2025*
Hack into a server's network and defeat its defenses.
![Deckers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_380846f6.jpg)

8. **Abroad**
*2025*
Travel through Europe for 28 days to showcase your abilities.
![Abroad](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_3764d542.png)

9. **Magical Athlete**
*2025*
Pit a cast of crazy characters against each other in a madcap race to the finish.
![Magical Athlete](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_08d584de.png)

*2025*
Step into the shoes of an iconic Star Trek captain and explore the galaxy!

*2025*
As members of The Fellowship, embark on a journey to save—or doom—Middle-earth.

*2026*
Investigate clues and battle monsters while traveling on the Orient Express!

*2027*

*2026*

Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects.
![Ark Nova](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_8f36b4f7.jpg)

22. **Gunsen: The Battle for Toshi Ranbo**
*2026*
The Great Clans of Rokugan wage war for control of the legendary fortress.
![Gunsen: The Battle for Toshi Ranbo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_909e0dc9.jpg)

*2005*
Build train routes across Europe in this sequel to the hit family board game.

24. **Eternal Decks**
*2025*
Can you solve each stage before your deck runs out?
![Eternal Decks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_897629eb.png)

25. **The Old King's Crown**
*2025*
Out-manoeuvre your rivals as you vie for control of an ancient, crumbling kingdom.
![The Old King's Crown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Derushir/Kepek/main/2026-09-11/toplist/bgg_1eb7c4fb.jpg)
